title: Purple Hammer Warrior
description: A confident female warrior stands in a wide fighting stance holding a large ornate purple warhammer. She wears orange and purple tribal-style armor with cropped top, baggy pants, and matching boots against a solid dark gray background.
prompt: A fierce young East Asian female warrior with long dark hair in a topknot stands in a powerful wide stance, smiling confidently. She wields a massive ornate purple warhammer with both hands. Wearing an orange cropped top with tribal patterns, purple and orange baggy pants, knee pads, and matching boots with purple wraps. Solid dark gray background, clean studio lighting, highly detailed fantasy character design.
